// Generated from Source/Editor/Full. Do not edit this template directly.
#if UNITY_EDITOR
using System.Collections.Generic;
using UnityEditor;
using UnityEngine;

namespace RVFX.DestructionSystem
{
    internal sealed partial class RVFXPortablePlaybackEditor
    {
        internal static List<ParticleSystem> FindEffectScalingWarnings(RVFXPieceTransformPlayback playback)
        {
            var result = new List<ParticleSystem>();
            if (!playback.TryValidatePlaybackTransform(out _) ||
                Mathf.Abs(RVFXPlaybackTransformValidation.WorldScale(playback.transform) - 1) <= RVFXPlaybackTransformValidation.Tolerance)
                return result;
            var data = playback.playbackEffects;
            if (data == null) return result;
            var seen = new HashSet<GameObject>();
            void Inspect(RVFXDestructionEffectBinding binding)
            {
                if (binding == null || !binding.enabled || binding.prefab == null || !seen.Add(binding.prefab)) return;
                foreach (var ps in binding.prefab.GetComponentsInChildren<ParticleSystem>(true))
                    if (ps.main.scalingMode != ParticleSystemScalingMode.Hierarchy) result.Add(ps);
            }
            if (data.filterVersion > 0)
            {
                if (data.filters != null) foreach (var filter in data.filters)
                    if (filter != null && filter.enabled && filter.effects != null)
                        foreach (var binding in filter.effects) Inspect(binding);
            }
            else if (data.bindings != null) foreach (var binding in data.bindings) Inspect(binding);
            return result;
        }

        private void DrawTransformValidation(RVFXPieceTransformPlayback playback)
        {
            if (!playback.TryValidatePlaybackTransform(out string error))
                EditorGUILayout.HelpBox(error + "\nPlayback and scrubbing are blocked until the Transform is valid.", MessageType.Error);
            var warnings = FindEffectScalingWarnings(playback);
            if (warnings.Count == 0) return;
            var message = new System.Text.StringBuilder("Effect scaling mismatch. Set Scaling Mode to Hierarchy on the following Particle Systems so they scale with Playback (including nested children):");
            foreach (var ps in warnings)
                message.Append("\n• ").Append(AnimationUtility.CalculateTransformPath(ps.transform, null)).Append(" — ").Append(ps.main.scalingMode);
            message.Append("\nPlayback is allowed. Keep Local/Shape only if independent effect sizing is intentional.");
            EditorGUILayout.HelpBox(message.ToString(), MessageType.Warning);
            if (GUILayout.Button("Select Particle System"))
            {
                Selection.activeObject = warnings[0];
                EditorGUIUtility.PingObject(warnings[0]);
            }
        }
    }
}
#endif
